audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven rows disagreed with the audited mirror, and level 6 was given to Yorick outright.
audit.why: singed__yorick.json sets Yorick / Yorick / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Yorick. Six belongs to Singed because Insanity Potion is the direct answer to the ability the whole Yorick pattern rests on, and two items belongs to Yorick because tower-taking beats proxying.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverse to the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said your level 6 'flips tempo back to you' and never mentioned Insanity Potion at all.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a flat 100-second cooldown that grants combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 — his six comes back faster than yours and directly counters it.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Singed's: his 100s ultimate halves Last Rites' heal while yours is on 160s. Spend Eulogy on plates, not on a duel in the poison.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent from every field: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds. Fling was also described as a plain 'flip' with no cooldown, no range and no mention of its root condition.
audit.why: Last Rites heals Yorick on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cycle and is the reason he wins extended trades; Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail halves it for the whole ultimate. Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at only 125 range, and Riot's text says a target flung into Mega Adhesive is also rooted — so the flip is dangerous only where the goo already is.
audit.corrected: Trade before Insanity Potion comes up; once it lands, Last Rites' heal is halved. Fling roots only if it drops you in Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1) — stand off the goo and it is just a reposition.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is right — no cooldown numbers anywhere. breakdown.cooldowns just said 'bait his flip'.
audit.why: Fling 10s, Mega Adhesive 17s, Insanity Potion 100s at rank 1 are the three clocks in this lane.
